jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs_results.description: Job Title Senior QA Engineer Summary: We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to join our team, contributing to the quality assurance of our products and services. In this role, you will leverage your advanced technical knowledge to influence decisions, define test strategies, design test cases, execute tests, manage defects, and report on test activities. You will also play a key role in mentoring team members, sharing knowledge, and promoting quality assurance best practices. In this role you will: Attend specification/architecture reviews and provide feedback, ensuring alignment with quality guidelines and industry best practices. Define test strategies and plans, ensuring traceability with specifications and customer requirements. Design test cases, prepare test environments, and execute test cases, providing sign-off on tested features. Assess the necessity for test automation and contribute to the improvement of test automation frameworks. Open defects, assign severity levels... verify fixes, and provide visibility on test activities to stakeholders. Efficiently use QA tooling stack and frameworks, proposing improvements and staying proactive about issues and changes. Drive proposals for continuous improvement in quality processes and participate in implementing new tools and technologies. Contribute to understanding, measuring, and reducing the environmental impact of tested applications and QA activities. About the ideal candidate: Experience in software functional testing (manual and automated), based on ISTQB principles. Experience in Backend and API testing, Experience in testing tools such as RobotFramework. Postman is a plus Knowledge of coding language and building testing libraries (Python or another language) Experience in an Agile environment Scrum. SAFe is a plus. Basic knowledge about the implementation of QA regression in a CI/CD pipeline (Jenkins, Docker usage) is a plus. UI Test automation is a plus. If you're ready to make an impact and drive quality excellence in a dynamic environment, apply now to join our team as a Senior QA Engineer. What we can offer you Add your voice to a multicultural team of 16,000+ professionals. Work at one of the world’s top 15 software companies. Challenge yourself to find solutions to complex problems. Flexible hybrid work from 1-2 days per week. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Application process Create your candidate profile in our system and upload your recent resume! Once you have applied, you’ll receive feedback within 15 days. Are you ready to leave your footprint? Be the power behind better journeys. #LI-EMEA Diversity & Inclusion We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and seek to hire the best candidate regardless of age, beliefs, disability, ethnicity, gender or sexual orientation. At Amadeus we’re passionate about travel and technology and making travel simpler, smarter and smoother. We're a diverse global team of over 18,000 professionals working together to solve the industry's toughest challenges and deliver exceptional customer experiences across 190 countries. And so can you! Join us to add your voice to our diverse mix for better discussions, decisions and outcomes for everyone

jobs_results.title: QA Engineer
jobs_results.via: via Madrona Venture Group Job Board
jobs_results.description:
QA Engineer

Location: Remote based in Spain/South Africa/The UK on CET/CAT or similar.

TROOP is a group meeting planning and travel management platform that helps companies bring teams together for in-person meetings. The experience starts with TROOP’s award-winning Intelligent Destination Recommendations, which use advanced algorithms to help meeting planners pinpoint the perfect meeting destination, considering travel time, climate impact, budget, lodging availability, and safety factors for all attendees.

Using TROOP, companies have saved millions in travel costs, employee time, and carbon emissions, making it possible for people to meet and build stronger relationships with their colleagues, clients, and partners, even in times of tightening budgets and travel restrictions.

Why TROOP?

TROOP believes in the power of shared experiences and the unifying impact of in-person meetings. We are on a mission to bring people together by transforming the meeting planning process.

At... TROOP, we have ambitious goals to be the leading provider of end-to-end meeting planning tools. We started by inventing a completely new way for people to decide where to meet, but for us, the destination is just the beginning. We’re developing more innovative solutions that make it easier than ever to organize and host successful group meeting experiences.

TROOP's Culture?

TROOP is an international, remote-first company. Our colleagues are spread across the globe, with entities in Spain, South Africa, the UK, and the United States. Our culture is rooted in an African philosophy called "Ubuntu," which means "I am because we are." It refers to an environment of interdependence through trust. We call ourselves TROOPers, and we are people who seek adventure, challenge the status quo, enjoy innovating, and want to be part of something special. We are doers who roll up our sleeves and get into the details; we own the problem and only stop once it is solved.

What you'll be doing:
• Create, enhance, and maintain test automation frameworks that can scale with the application's growth.
• Collaborate with Product Owners and Tech Leads to design testing plans and facilitate releases for significant features.
• Propose and implement automated testing solutions to reduce the need for manual QA processes.
• Identify and report any bugs or issues discovered during testing.
• Be able to find the root cause of issues found by external and internal parties to TROOP.
• Understand technical requirements from an engineering perspective and client expectations and behaviors.
• Verify that feature releases meet quality standards before sign-off from a testing perspective.
• Utilize applications within the QA environment and identify analytics and tracking issues.
• Conduct various tests, including functional, load, stress, performance, and usability testing, to ensure that the software is reliable and performs optimally

jobs_results.description:
At Hexa Consulting we want to spread transparency and enable diverse tech careers. Based in Portugal, we can answer the increasing demand in the IT sector.

Our mission is to build strong relationships, be a leading partner through a differentiated approach in IT consulting and contribute to the professional and personal development of our team.

We work with Nearshore projects, TM & Project Development, Service Management and Tech Academies.

Responsibilities:
• Perform functional, compatibility, and performance testing on applications for STB platforms.
• Create and execute detailed test cases to ensure the quality and usability of products.
• Identify, document, and report bugs and quality issues clearly and concisely.

Requirements:
• Fluency in both Spanish and English, both oral and written.
• Minimum of 2 years of proven experience as a QA in software development.
• Practical experience with Set-Top Box (STB) tools and testing in related environments.
• Strong analytical and... problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team.

What do we offer?
• B2B contract
• Health insurance
• Career development
• Access to Training

If you’re living in Portugal or in the EU, and are looking for the right opportunity, don’t waste your time. Be part of this amazing journey!

It’s never just business, we always make it personal

jobs_results.title: Qa tester
jobs_results.description:
En ALTEN buscamos incorporar a un QA Tester para trabajar con un importante cliente del sector defensa en Madrid, con modalidad mixta de teletrabajo, para trabajar en un proyecto de sistemas de control de fronteras.

¿En que tareas te verás involucrado/a?
- Validar los productos y componentes ya sea puramente software o combinando software y hardware.
- Cooperar con los desarrolladores para reproducir, identificar y aislar los problemas.
- Definir la estrategia de integración y participar en la redacción del plan de pruebas de aceptación: desarrollo, integración y aceptación en las instalaciones del cliente.
- Garantizar que todos los entregables estén completos con la documentación con el nivel de seguridad y calidad requeridos, y adaptados a un entorno determinado según los requisitos del proyecto.
- Preparar el material de formación a los usuarios finales.

Requisitos:
- Al menos dos años de experiencia de integración, verificación y/o validación de software
- Valorable experiencia... con hardware
- Herramientas de test: SOAP UI, JMeter, Postman
- Tecnologías web y bases de datos
- Inglés alto: B2-C1
- Disponibilidad para viajar puntualmente

¿Quiénes somos?
ALTEN es una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español. Con una cifra de negocio a nivel mundial de más de 1.900 millones de euros, cuenta con una plantilla de 28.000 profesionales y está presente en 21 países.

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?
- Incorporación a una empresa multinacional competitiva en continuo crecimiento.
- Integración en un equipo de profesionales altamente cualificado, con un buen clima laboral, innovador y dinámico.
- Formación especializada y desarrollo profesional continuo.
- Beneficios Sociales y Plan de compensación flexible.
- Retribución competitiva

jobs_results.title: QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
En Interactiv4 buscamos un QA Engineer, para nuestra oficina de Madrid o Barcelona, perfil senior experto en Calidad, con capacidad para definir la estrategia de QA en nuestros proyectos.

Se requiere
• Experiencia participando en el desarrollo y automatización de planes de pruebas de proyectos eCommerce
• Experiencia en implementación de distintos niveles de pruebas: unitarias, integración, end-to-end.
• Experiencia en gestión de planes de mejora/calidad.
• Experiencia en Pruebas de Carga/Stress en entornos de producción.
• Experiencia en pruebas de API y Frontend.
• Experiencia en creación de planes de pruebas y generación de reportes dentro de los ciclos de desarrollo.
• Experiencia en definición de criterios de aceptación de las historias de usuario.

Descripción de tareas
• Entender, implementar y mantener actualizada la estrategia de QA.
• Trabajar en equipo para definir los criterios de aceptación y las definiciones de hecho de las historias de usuario.
• Desarrollar los test... plans a partir de las historias de usuarios, así como la redacción de Test Cases y la línea base para las pruebas de aceptación.
• Estimar, priorizar, planificar y coordinar actividades de testing.
• Asegurar que el equipo de trabajo conozca y use adecuadamente las herramientas de testing.
• Diseñar, desarrollar y ejecutar scripts de automatización.
• Ejecutar Test Cases incluyendo pruebas manuales y automatizadas del sistema contra los requisitos (funcionales y no funcionales).
• Reportar los errores (bugs) y trabajar con los desarrolladores en su resolución.
• Llevar a cabo testing de regresiones cuando los bugs se hayan resuelto.
• Hacer coaching a QA Testers del equipo.
• Asegurar que las actividades de Testing sean incluidas en la planificación de la iteración y de salidas a producción.

Se Valorará
• Conocimiento de la plataforma eCommerce Magento
• Conocimiento en pruebas de rendimiento, y herramientas tipo Selenium, Jenkins, Xray.
• Valorable experiencia previa como desarrollador.
• Conocimiento en tratamiento de datos y data quality.
• Valorable experiencia en construcción de workflows de integración continua y entrega continua.
• Habilidades de formación sobre conceptos de calidad en los equipos.

Requisitos
• Estudios mínimos: Ingenierías Técnicas (informática, telecomunicaciones). No se descartan candidatos con otros estudios, pero con experiencia como ingeniero QA.
• Alto nivel de Inglés

Interactiv4 Ofrece
• Estabilidad laboral, contrato indefinido, y proyección profesional.
• Incorporación a un equipo altamente cualificado y dentro de un entorno tecnológico avanzado en el que están integradas las últimas soluciones del mercado.
• Beneficios Sociales: cheques comida, guardería, transporte

jobs_results.description:
Necesitamos incorporar un QA Manager para liderar las pruebas funcionales y de carga que sirvan para garantizar la calidad del código que se genera en las distintas versiones de nuestra plataforma de validación de talento.

- Supervisión de la actividad del equipo de QA
- Coordinación con el equipo de producto para la especificación de las pruebas de integración a realizar por cada funcionalidad desarrollada
- Automatización de las pruebas especificadas mediante el uso de Cypress, Selenium o similar
- Especificación y ejecución de las pruebas de carga con JMeter o similar y el entorno de monitorización de Kubernetes en Google Cloud

- Formación universitaria mínima de grado en ingeniería software o similar
- Experiência de 3 a 5 años en departamento de QA de productos software con foco en la automatización
- Conocimientos de... los entornos de monitorización de nube pública

jobs_results.title: Quality Assurance Tester
jobs_results.description:
MercurySteam, estudio AAA español, continúa creciendo y mejorando con el afán de seguir desarrollando experiencias que emocionen a jugadores de todo el mundo y en todas las plataformas como “Castlevania Lords of Shadow”, “Spacelords”, “Metroid: Samus Returns” y “Metroid Dread”. Para ello estamos en busca de un/una Quality Assurance Tester para que se incorpore al equipo y nos acompañe en nuestras aventuras. ¿Quieres ser tú?
Requisitos mínimos

• Conocimiento de los procesos que forman parte del desarrollo de un videojuego y de los equipos involucrados en el mismo.
• Gran capacidad analítica.
• Excelente organización interpersonal.
• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y presentación.
• Capacidad para recibir y aplicar feedback positivamente.
• Una ética de trabajo positiva y proactiva.
Requisitos deseados

Experiencia haciendo testing de QA en juegos AA o AAA desde su concepción hasta su lanzamiento.
• Experiencia haciendo testing de Certificacion en juegos AA o AAA desde su concepción... hasta su lanzamiento.
• Experiencia trabajando con test kits de desarrollo de consolas (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo).
• Experiencia trabajando con equipos multidisciplinares amplios (+30 personas).
• Experiencia realizando reportes de bugs y gestionándolos con programas de gestión de incidencias (JIRA, Mantis).
• Experiencia trabajando con Perforce o control de versiones similar.
• Español e inglés fluido, tanto oral como escrito (nivel mínimo: B2).
Responsabilidades

Como QA Tester en MercurySteam jugarás un papel clave en el control de calidad, ayudando a crear juegos libres de bugs y creando una experiencia de usuario positiva en nuestros proyectos. Colaborarás estrechamente con un equipo de QA Testers y QA Engenieers, y tendrás contacto con equipos muy diferenciados como Diseño, Arte y Programación, para ayudar a crear una experiencia interactiva completa e inmersiva que balancee las necesidades del diseño de gameplay, la dirección de arte y la experiencia de usuario.
• Realizar testing manual del proyecto siguiendo test suites y test plans definidos por el Lead de QA.
• Reportar bugs y errores detectados.
• Realizar Verificaciones y Regressions de los bugs corregidos.
• Apoyo a las pruebas automatizadas de los QA Engenieers.
• Conocimiento del proyecto para identificar riesgos y realizar el testing adecuadamente.
Beneficios

• Hacemos juegos AAA con un gran componente artesanal en los que todos los integrantes del equipo contribuyen activamente.
• Entre 29 y 34 días de vacaciones al año: 23 de ellos a tu libre elección y el resto durante el periodo navideño y completamente financiados por el estudio.
• El equilibrio entre la vida laboral y personal es algo que respetamos, protegemos e incentivamos:
• Dispondrás de hasta un mes de teletrabajo al año, dividido a tu libre elección, para que puedas organizarte con la mayor flexibilidad.
• No alimentamos la cultura del Crunch.
• Posibilidad de jornada continua todos los días y horario flexible de entrada (8 a 10 de la mañana).
• Posibilidad de participación en beneficios al tercer año.
• Seguro médico privado.
• Mejora constante de nuestras herramientas y procesos para que puedas centrarte en la creatividad.
• Excelente ambiente de trabajo en compañía de profesionales altamente cualificados, que te ayudarán a sacar partido de tu potencial.
• Salario acorde a experiencia y capacidades.

--------Contacto--------

Si quieres formar parte de nuestro equipo, envíanos tu CV y enlace a tu porfolio/reel a:
Ver el correo electrónico en stratos-ad.com Asunto: QA Tester - Nombre candidato/a

Todas las muestras recibidas se considerarán confidenciales

jobs_results.description:
Role: Lead QA Engineer

Company: Pearson

Division: English Language Learning

Location: Madrid, Spain (Remote or Hybrid*)

About Pearson:

Our purpose: At Pearson we ‘add life to a lifetime of learning’ so everyone can realise the life they imagine. We do this by creating vibrant and enriching learning experiences designed for real-life impact. Pearson was founded in 1844 and has been built on our ability to grow with and adapt to a constantly evolving market. Our 20,000+ employees are dedicated to creating the high-quality, digital-first, accessible and sustainable resources for lifelong learning.

About English Language Learning:

In the English Language Learning (ELL) business unit, we aspire to become the world's leading destination to learn and improve English language skills. Our focus is on committed learners from around the world, who are motivated by outcomes because they want to reach their full potential through learning English.

Role overview:

The English Language... Learning (ELL) division of Pearson is looking for a talented and motivated professional to join our growing organization as a QA Lead Engineer.

As a QA Lead, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the robustness and reliability of our products, working closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders. You will lead our QAs, hands-on, to a quality driven mindset where we always put our customers, first, and proactively break our product to ensure that our customers get the best possible, bug free, experience.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead testing efforts across backend, frontend, mobile, and REST APIs.
• Plan and lead software testing, setting priorities in collaboration with the POs – our teams are spread across the globe
• Establish, lead, maintain and continuously improve a suite of robust testing processes throughout development, pre-production, and post-release phases.
• Continuously enhance our automated testing suite, ensuring comprehensive coverage of critical system components.
• Promote high degree of QA automation as part of a CI/CD pipelines.
• Define, document and enforce best practice SDLC processes and standards.
• Collaborate with developers, product owners, and customer success managers to deeply understand customer business and use cases.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and troubleshoot defects and bugs, and working to resolve these issues in a timely manner
• Be responsible for testing tools, including but not limited to Mocha, Java + Selenide, Selenium, React Testing Library, Playright, Cypress, and Postman.
• Developing and executing test plans and test cases
• Verify the functionality and performance of software products and applications
• Developing and maintaining automated test scripts
• Participating in code reviews and providing feedback on code quality and testability
• Creating and maintaining automated test suites to increase efficiency and effectiveness
• Participating in release management processes

Qualifications & Skills:
• 6+ years of Agile ways of working, and software development cycle.
• 6+ years of experience in automation suites and manual testing
• ISTQB certification - Test Manager level – is a plus
• Proactive, curious, and driven mindset with a passion for breaking and improving software.
• Ability to deeply understand customer business needs and use cases to ensure software quality.
• Must have strong Leadership skills to support QA team members, and identify/resolve QA challenges through mentoring and guidance,
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional remote teams.
• Detail-oriented, analytical, and possess strong technical skills to ensure that the software meets the required quality standards
• Proficient in at least one programming language, preferably Java
• Experience with Agile and team collaboration tools such as JIRA
• Critical thinking skills to recommend original and productive ideas
• Ability to work effectively with agility and resilience in a fast-paced environment
• Ability to analyse data and information to identify patterns and trends that may indicate problems with the software
• Ability to prioritize tasks effectively and manage their time efficiently to meet project deadlines
• Willing to learn innovative technologies and tools to stay up to date with the latest developments in software testing
• Passion for education and learning

Pearson’s Benefits:
• 24 Days annual leave (increasing by 1 day with every 2 years of continuous service up to 30 days)
• Life insurance Policy
• Work-Life Balance Benefits
• Family Benefits
• Complementary Benefits
• Development and Training Benefits
• Access to Pearson+: Pearson´s digital library
• Discounts on books
• Development and training: a wide access to internal learning platforms and development plan

Diversity: At Pearson we value the power of an inclusive culture and a strong sense of belonging. We promote a culture wheredifferences are embraced as strengths and opportunities are equal and accessible.

Flexible working: Pearson is committed to hybrid working practices and has adopted flexible remote and virtual working. Where possible our employees can choose to manage their attendance to the office more flexibly.

How to apply: Thank you for your interest in applying for a role at Pearson. Please submit an updated CV and cover letter (optional) in English. If you have any additional questions or require further information, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.

What to expect from Pearson

Did you know Pearson is one of the 10 most innovative education companies of 2022?

At Pearson, we add life to a lifetime of learning so everyone can realize the life they imagine. We do this by creating vibrant and enriching learning experiences designed for real-life impact. We are on a journey to be 100 percent digital to meet the changing needs of the global population by developing a new strategy with ambitious targets. To deliver on our strategic vision, we have five business divisions that are the foundation for the long-term growth of the company: Assessment & Qualifications, Virtual Learning, English Language Learning, Workforce Skills and Higher Education. Alongside these, we have our corporate divisions: Digital & Technology, Finance, Global Corporate Marketing & Communications, Human Resources, Legal, Strategy and Direct to Consumer. Learn more at We are Pearson.

We value the power of an inclusive culture and also a strong sense of belonging. We promote a culture where differences are embraced, opportunities are accessible, consideration and respect are the norm and all individuals are supported in reaching their full potential. Through our talent, we believe that diversity, equity and inclusion make us a more innovative and vibrant place to work. People are at the center, and we are committed to building a workplace where talent can learn, grow and thrive.

Pearson is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. We want a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We strive for a workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities.

To learn more about Pearson’s commitment to a diverse and inclusive workforce, navigate to: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Pearson.

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing ppsmhr@pearson.com.

Note that the information you provide will stay confidential and will be stored securely. It will not be seen by those involved in making decisions as part of the recruitment process.
